verdict.rationale: Jira offers REST APIs, 3000+ marketplace integrations, cross-tool tracking (Slack/Figma/Gmail) and an official Atlassian MCP server, all of which enable structured handoff of work items and context to other tools/agents. However, there is no concrete evidence of context/information being preserved end-to-end during multi-agent or multi-tool handoffs, and community feedback notes data-loss and UI issues that could undermine reliability of such handoffs. Missing for 10: hands-on validation of agent-to-agent handoff without context loss, and documentation of how MCP server exposes full ticket context versus partial fields.
